plugins.name: OrbisNet.sprx
plugins.description: It is a fully recreated PSN Emulation, what this means is that the account system has been recreated and all sort of calls to PSN are instead redirected to OrbisNet's Backend. Which is just a fake PSN and our own server so nothing touches PSN's actual servers, To use it, you need to create an account on their Discord server

plugins.name: afr.prx
plugins.description: An essential PS4 plugin that hooks into the game at startup to dynamically replace and modify game files on the fly, enabling seamless installation of major game mods (such as Souls and Capcom game mods).How to use:To find the original game files, the game must be running, then navigate to:/mnt/sandbox/[Game_CUSA]_00/app0 ;Place the files you want to replace inside your plugin directory path: data/GoldHEN/AFR/[Game_CUSA]/
plugins.author: illusion

plugins.name: ElysiumNet.prx
plugins.description: A custom PS4 plugin that connects to the Elysium Net private server network. To use it, you need to log in to the website with your account, go to the Dashboard, navigate to Plugin, and check 'our Elysium Code' to get your token.
plugins.author: TMP

plugins.name: force_1080p_display.prx
plugins.description: A custom PS4 plugin that forces games to display and output at a fixed 1080p resolution, helping to improve performance and framerate stability in titles with dynamic or higher default resolutions.
plugins.author: illusion

plugins.name: force_30_fps.prx
plugins.description: A custom PS4 plugin that forces games to run at a locked 30 Frames Per Second (30 FPS) cap, eliminating framerate fluctuations and delivering a smoother, more consistent gameplay experience in demanding titles.
